name: HRC_ALERT_RUNS
description: Contains alert run data with totals no of success, error and warning counts.

columns.name: RUN_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key column.

columns.name: PARENT_RUN_ID
columns.description: Run Identifier of Parent. Foreign Key to HRC_ALERTS_RUNS.RUN_ID

columns.name: ALERT_ID
columns.description: Alert Identifier. Foreign Key to HRC_ALERTS_B.ALERT_ID

columns.name: RUN_START
columns.description: Specifies the start of the run activity.

columns.name: RUN_END
columns.description: Specifies the end of the run activity.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Determines the status of the activity run. Valid values are defined in lookup of HRC_ALERT_RUN_STATUS.

columns.name: USER_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: User Identifier.

columns.name: RUN_PHASE
columns.description: Run Phase of child job

columns.name: PARAMETERS
columns.description: Contains parameters values for the run.

columns.name: RUN_OPTIONS
columns.description: Contains config run option values for the run.

columns.name: LOG
columns.description: Contains a log for the activity run.

columns.name: TOTAL_ALERT_INSTANCES
columns.description: The total number of Alert Instances raised

columns.name: TOTAL_MESSAGES
columns.description: The total number of messages created for the run. TOTAL_SUCCESS_MESSAGES + TOTAL_WARNING_MESSAGES + TOTAL_ERROR_MESSAGES

columns.name: TOTAL_WARNINGS
columns.description: Total number of warnings.

columns.name: TOTAL_ERRORS
columns.description: The total number or errors for the run.

columns.name: TOTAL_KEEPS
columns.description: Total number of keeps.

columns.name: TOTAL_SUCCESS_MESSAGES
columns.description: Total number of successful messages.

columns.name: TOTAL_WARNING_MESSAGES
columns.description: Total number of warning messages.

columns.name: TOTAL_ERROR_MESSAGES
columns.description: Total number of error messages

columns.name: TOTAL_KEEP_MESSAGES
columns.description: Total number of keep messages.

columns.name: TOTAL_SUCCESS_RECIPIENTS
columns.description: Total number of successful recipients.

columns.name: TOTAL_ERROR_RECIPIENTS
columns.description: Total number of recipients in error for an error message

columns.name: TOTAL_WARNING_RECIPIENTS
columns.description: Total number of warning recipients.

columns.name: TOTAL_KEEP_RECIPIENTS
columns.description: Total number of keep recipients.

columns.name: RUN_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: Phase1 Run Group Identifier.

columns.name: RUN_CANCEL_FLAG
columns.description: Identifier used to detect cancelation of a run.

columns.name: RUN_INT_VALUE1
columns.description: Used to store Internal Value for a run.

columns.name: RUN_INT_VALUE2
columns.description: Used to store Internal Value for a run.

columns.name: RUN_INT_VALUE3
columns.description: Used to store Internal Value for a run.

columns.name: RUN_INT_VALUE4
columns.description: Used to store Internal Value for a run.

columns.name: RETRY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of Retries.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
